source.scope: Pinned Teyvat BlessDomain entrances and all canonical artifact sets. supported means static source mapping only, not live unlock, guide demand, OCR or combat verification. Missing keys are unsupported.
source.coordinates: x=tp.position[2], y=tp.position[0], matching GiWorldPosition.X/Y and native AutoDomain teleport; not tranPosition.
source.challengeSelection: Unique greatest recommendedLevel, then unlockRank, among exact entranceName UI_ABYSSUS_RELIC records. Full source title is preserved; ties or mismatches are unsupported. challengeBase removes only the final space and Roman difficulty from the proven full title, preserving the prefix and exact base name for guide matching.
source.sets: domains.sets lists all artifact sets in the selected challenge rewardPreview; featuredSets preserves the native map rewards. sets[name].domains lists proven supported highest-challenge sources, not a priority order; multiple sources require explicit selection.
source.identifiers: sets[name].id is the artifact-set ID; rewardPreview[].id is a set/rarity preview ID, not a piece ID. pieces maps source slot to exact piece name. Numeric piece IDs are not provided by the pinned artifact records and are omitted.
source.rarities: sets[name].rarities lists canonical set rarities; domain rewardPreview specifies which rarities are advertised at that challenge. No drop rates, guaranteed yields or inventory counts are implied.
